name: W Algarve Hotel & Residences

address.street: Estrada da Galé Sesmarias - CX Postal 290

insider_take: This ultra-modern W property brings New York-style glamour to Portugal's stunning southern coastline, where dramatic cliffs meet pristine beaches in one of Europe's most coveted destinations.
whats_special: The W Algarve is uniquely positioned on the cliff-top overlooking Falesia Beach, one of Portugal's most photographed stretches of sand with its iconic red limestone formations. The hotel features Portugal's largest rooftop infinity pool and is just minutes from the charming fishing village of Olhos de Água, where locals still practice traditional net fishing techniques dating back centuries.
pro_tip: Book a cliff-facing room for sunrise views over the Atlantic, then head down the private beach access path during golden hour when the red cliffs create the most Instagram-worthy backdrop.
dont_miss: The nearby Benagil Cave, accessible only by kayak or boat, is considered one of the world's most beautiful sea caves. Also explore the historic town of Tavira with its Roman bridge and traditional Portuguese architecture, just a 30-minute drive east along the coast.
pros: Contemporary luxury design with W Hotels signature style
Prime Algarve coastline location with stunning ocean views
Modern residences offering extended stay accommodations
Vibrant nightlife and sophisticated entertainment venues
cons: Contemporary style may not suit traditional preferences
